title: Build CS1 campus operations decision core
acceptance_criteria: Campus state snapshots use aggregate campus/building/time-window signals only and carry explicit canonical source provenance, decision-time cutoffs, and readiness semantics

Shuttle planning emits capacity-sensitive output only from verified capacity provenance, recommends bounded seat/headway capacity from aggregate demand and fleet constraints, and never invents trips that do not fit the service window

Classroom allocation emits capacity-sensitive assignments only from verified room-inventory and attendance provenance and enforces capacity, accessibility, equipment, time-conflict, and campus constraints before soft utilization/energy scoring

Food operations chooses only operator-reviewed production targets from explicit demand scenarios, capacity, registered sensitivity weights, and actionable method eligibility; a non-identifying zero-weight objective is withheld and no automatic kitchen dispatch is permitted
Building energy operations converts aggregate occupancy into operator-review modes using explicit registered thresholds and never emits BMS commands or achieved energy/carbon/cost savings
Shared-capacity operations allocates aggregate integer capacity by registered minimums and priorities, rejects person-level allocation data, and requires operator review
Cross-domain portfolio keeps dining, mobility, classroom, occupancy, energy, and shared-resource effects as separate decision-support signals and never auto-executes university operations
No student identifiers, BUCard identifiers, scholarship data, device/Wi-Fi client identifiers, or inferred individual movement profiles are accepted by the decision contracts
Canonical provenance states and documented aliases are enforced without promoting unsupported inputs into verified capacity evidence
Missing, contradictory, future-leaking, or unverified required evidence produces WITHHOLD or REVIEW_REQUIRED instead of a confident recommendation

Focused regression tests cover nominal, oversubscribed, malformed, conflicting, accessibility/equipment, insufficient-evidence, provenance gating, food eligibility/objective edge cases, energy thresholds, shared capacity, and API orchestration cases
FastAPI exposes domain endpoints and one combined campus-operations planning endpoint without claiming live BMS, shuttle GPS, turnstile, Wi-Fi, POS, or registrar integrations
notes: This task extends the existing food-focused CS1 decision intelligence into reusable campus operations without editing active food-core owned paths.

Food-ops, building-energy, and shared-capacity policy files added concurrently on the same task branch were reviewed and accepted because they use the shared aggregate campus contract, retain explicit human review, and preserve the evidence boundary.
The combined API supports campus state, shuttle, classroom, food operations, building energy, shared-capacity allocation, and a cross-domain portfolio under one decision-time-aware contract.
Capacity-sensitive shuttle and classroom decisions now require verified provenance rather than treating model estimates as physical truth.
The task deliberately avoids fabricating PMR, pilot outcomes, live telemetry, or achieved sustainability impact.
Campus operations are advisory decision support; irreversible operational execution remains outside this package.
